catatan: Uji workflow owner (v3.93): 10 klip, klip 1 dan 6 gambar baru dengan foto acuan, sisanya sambung frame terakhir, Enhance ON, prompt natural, baju ganti sesuai keadaan (piyama lalu baju shalat).
lokasi: A small Indonesian family house before dawn.
latar: quiet house before dawn, faint crickets outside

klip.pakaian: a loose light-grey long-sleeved cotton pajama shirt and matching light-grey pajama trousers, barefoot
klip.lokasi: A small, tidy Indonesian teenage boy's bedroom before dawn: a single bed with a rumpled blue blanket, a wooden desk, a closed wooden door, a small warm lamp glowing on the desk, dark blue sky outside the window.

kamera.posisi: behind Uwais at chest height, a little to his left
kamera.fokus: Uwais sitting on the edge of his bed

klip.awal: Uwais sits upright on the edge of his bed with both feet on the floor, seen from behind, the warm desk lamp glowing.

aksi.aksi: He stretches both arms up slowly and lowers them.
He stands up from the bed.

klip.akhir: Uwais stands next to the bed, seen from behind.

foley.suara: a distant adzan subuh from the mosque

kamera.gerak: following him slowly at the same speed

klip.awal: Uwais stands next to the bed.

aksi.aksi: He walks at normal speed to the closed bedroom door.
He opens the door with his right hand.
aksi.kamera: the camera stays right behind his shoulders

klip.akhir: Uwais stands in the open doorway, seen from behind.

kamera.fokus: Uwais walking toward the bathroom door at the end of the hallway

klip.aksi: He walks along the dim hallway to the bathroom door at the end and stops in front of it.
klip.akhir: Uwais stands in front of the bathroom door, seen from behind.

kamera.posisi: behind Uwais, over his right shoulder
kamera.fokus: his hands under the running tap

klip.awal: Uwais stands at the bathroom sink, seen from behind.

aksi.aksi: He turns on the tap with his right hand.
He washes both hands under the running water, rubbing them together.

klip.akhir: Uwais stands at the sink with wet hands, seen from behind.

kamera.gerak: following him back down the hallway

klip.aksi: He turns off the tap, turns around, and walks back along the hallway toward the living room.
klip.akhir: Uwais walks into the living room, seen from behind.

klip.pakaian: a clean white long-sleeved koko shirt with a standing collar, a dark green checkered sarong reaching the ankles, a plain white knitted peci on his head, barefoot
klip.lokasi: A calm Indonesian family living room before dawn: a green prayer mat laid on the floor facing a plain wall, a low wooden cabinet, a window with thin curtains, soft warm lamp light.

kamera.fokus: Uwais standing on the prayer mat

klip.awal: Uwais stands upright on the green prayer mat, seen from behind, facing the wall.
klip.aksi: He raises both open hands up beside his ears, then lowers them and folds his right hand over his left on his chest.
klip.akhir: Uwais stands still on the prayer mat with his hands folded on his chest, seen from behind.

kamera.gerak: moving slowly down to his level

klip.awal: Uwais stands on the prayer mat.

aksi.aksi: He sits down on the prayer mat with his legs folded under him.
He raises both open palms in front of his chest to pray.
aksi.ucapan: Ya Allah, terima kasih untuk pagi ini.

klip.akhir: Uwais sits on the prayer mat with his palms raised, seen from behind.

kamera.fokus: the window and the dawn light

klip.awal: Uwais sits on the prayer mat.

aksi.aksi: He stands up from the prayer mat.
He walks to the window and pulls the thin curtain open with both hands; soft pink dawn light fills the room.

klip.akhir: Uwais stands at the open window, seen from behind, dawn light on his shoulders.

kamera.posisi: in front of Uwais at chest height, inside the room
kamera.gerak: moving slowly backward as he walks forward

aksi.aksi: He turns around freely to face the room.
He walks forward toward the camera at normal speed.

klip.akhir: Uwais walks toward the camera, the bright window behind him.

kamera.gerak: turning to follow him as he walks past
kamera.fokus: Uwais walking toward the kitchen doorway

klip.aksi: He walks past the camera toward the kitchen doorway and goes through it.
klip.akhir: Uwais walks into the kitchen, seen from behind.
